supersedes: protocols/blind_analysis_plan.json stays valid; this file adds the v2 model and detectability clauses
primary_endpoint_model_reason: about 42 percent of the full model's split gain comes from tryptic detectability features, so the full model cannot carry a chemistry conclusion

preregistered_comparisons.name: full_vs_chem
preregistered_comparisons.permitted_interpretation: contribution of mass-spectrometry detectability to what was observed

preregistered_comparisons.name: chem_vs_random_within_detectable_subset
preregistered_comparisons.role: the only test in this plan that can support the existence of a chemical-environment ranking signal
preregistered_comparisons.failure_statement: current evidence does not support chemical ranking ability after conditioning on detectability

tie_rule: Top-1 coverage is the observed fraction among exactly tied maximum-score sites; Top-2 uses score descending then position ascending
missing_outcome_rule: not_testable and ambiguous_localization are reported, never silently converted to negative
not_testable_cross_table_required: not_testable fraction must be crossed with predicted detectability; descriptive only
claim_limits: no endpoint is a persulfidation occurrence probability
no endpoint is a success rate for the next experiment
every reported number must name the model that produced it
